# ARC Biologics
> Professional-grade peptide compounds for research. U.S.-sourced, triple-tested, Certificate of Analysis on every batch.

## About
ARC Biologics supplies 20+ research-grade peptide compounds sourced from trusted U.S. suppliers. Every batch undergoes a three-checkpoint testing process: identity verification (Certificate of Authenticity), sterility screening, and mycotoxin analysis. Purity standard: 99%+. All products are sold for laboratory and research use only.

## Products
- Recovery & Healing: BPC-157, TB-500, BPC-157/TB-500 Blend
- Cognitive & Neuro: Semax, Selank, Dihexa
- Anti-Aging & Longevity: GHK-Cu, Epithalon, SS-31
- Body Composition: AOD-9604, IGF-1 LR3, Tesamorelin, CJC-1295/Ipamorelin
- Blends & Stacks: Multi-compound formulations for synergistic research
- Performance: Endurance and physical performance peptides
